feature: 方河 Fang He, the rectangular pool east of 线法山: centre (mid of its four sides)
unchanged_because: the rectangular pool is kept (re-dug) in its old form and orientation; rounded ends and long sides match the plan
note: centre from the four sides; the south side on the imagery is half in tree shadow (+-4 m in y); the pool is about 143 x 45-54 m

feature: 正觉寺 Zhengjue Si, main hall south of the octagonal 文殊亭: centre of the hall
unchanged_because: 正觉寺 survived 1860; its halls stand (restored) on their own bases, octagon north of the main hall on both
note: read on the roof, which leans in the off-nadir image (2-4 m) and includes the front porch; plan centre of the hall body without porch

feature: 绮春园宫门 Qichun Yuan palace gate (大宫门): centre of the gate hall
unchanged_because: gate rebuilt 1988 on its old site (a later source); width 22 m today against 20 m on the plan, forecourt to its south, second gate about 35 m north on both
note: image: centre of the white roof (lean of a few m possible); plan: centre of the 5-bay hall, not of the terrace drawn south of it

feature: 方河 Fang He pool, NW corner (meeting of the north and west sides, extended past the rounding)
unchanged_because: the rectangular pool keeps its old form and orientation (re-dug on the old outline)
note: virtual corner from the two sides, both drawn with rounded corners; image sides read on the ice edge, north side tilted about 7 deg like the plan

feature: 方河 Fang He pool, NE corner (meeting of the north and east sides, extended past the rounding)
unchanged_because: the rectangular pool keeps its old form and orientation (re-dug on the old outline)
note: virtual corner; the east side on the imagery is soft (path and trees beside it), +-2 m; a large dark patch in the pool is open water or weed, not an island
